fusions.name: Scent Trail
fusions.desc: Throws a tracker that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 50% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A final lunge on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 24 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. You heal for 35% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Scent Taken
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 15 seconds. You restore 10 health when you use it.

fusions.name: Long Stalk
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Each kill restores 3 health to you. Once every 8 seconds.
